stems.stem: Alongside six million lives—including ____________ million children—a thousand-year ____________ civilisation was destroyed.

lesson_7.watch_out: Never reduce the six million to an abstract statistic—remember the diverse Yiddish and Sephardic families, languages, and cultures destroyed.
